briefing.headline: Harbour Town dominate through intense high press and central overload; Kestrel must stop central losses and high turnovers

working.text: Harbour press very aggressively (low PPDA) and win the ball high, creating sustained attacking pressure.
They control the game and create chances: higher possession and xG than Kestrel with many final-third entries.
Most Harbour entries come through the centre, giving them a clear focal route to goal.

not_working.text: Their press intensity may be hard to sustain — PPDA is low now and could rise later if legs tire.
Reliance on central attacks risks becoming predictable if Kestrel block the middle.

predictions.claim: Harbour will change where they attack to avoid predictability, increasing right-side final-third entries.
Kavanagh will accept a slightly lower press intensity as the half goes on, so Harbour's PPDA will rise.
Harbour will keep forcing turnovers high up to maintain danger, so Kestrel's central entries should fall.

working.text: Kestrel have struggled to press or win the ball high, conceding many high turnovers to Harbour.
They still play more of their centre entries through the middle when they do reach the final third.
Kestrel are behind in control and creation: lower control index and xG than Harbour.

not_working.text: Their low turnover height shows they rarely regain possession in advanced areas, leaving them vulnerable.
Their central vulnerability is costly: Harbour exploited the middle frequently.

predictions.claim: Gregor Molina will sit a midfielder deeper to reduce Harbour's high wins, cutting Harbour high regains.
Kestrel will try to crowd Harbour's centre to blunt their central entries, lowering Harbour centre channel entries.
If they push more players higher to chase the game, Kestrel's possession share should increase.

predictions.claim: Harbour variará las zonas de ataque para evitar previsibilidad, aumentando las entradas al último tercio por la derecha.

Harbour seguirá forzando recuperaciones altas para mantener el peligro, por lo que las entradas centrales de Kestrel deberían disminuir.

working.text: Kestrel ha tenido dificultades para presionar o ganar el balón alto, concediendo muchas pérdidas altas a Harbour.

not_working.text: Su baja altura de recuperaciones muestra que rara vez recuperan la posesión en zonas avanzadas, dejándolos vulnerables.

predictions.claim: Gregor Molina colocará a un mediocampista más retrasado para reducir las recuperaciones altas de Harbour, recortando sus recuperaciones en campo contrario.
